SELECT S.MERCHANT_ID, S.BASE_DATE, S.TX_SEQ,
S.SETTLEMENT_DATE, S.CARD_COMPANY,
S.AMOUNT, S.FEE_AMOUNT, S.VAT_AMOUNT, S.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT,
S.SETTLEMENT_STATUS,
( SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM MST_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_GROUP = 'SETTLEMENT_STATUS' AND C.CODE = S.SETTLEMENT_STATUS ) AS SETTLEMENT_STATUS_NAME,
S.CREATED_AT
FROM SETTLEMENT_CARD S
WHERE 1=1
AND S.MERCHANT_ID = #{dto.merchantId}
AND S.BASE_DATE >= #{dto.baseDateFrom}
AND S.BASE_DATE <= #{dto.baseDateTo}
AND S.SETTLEMENT_STATUS = #{dto.settlementStatus}
ORDER BY S.BASE_DATE DESC, S.TX_SEQ
OFFSET #{dto.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{dto.size} ROWS ONLY
